senses.gloss: (= אַזְעִי, v. אוּדְיָיתָא a. זִיעַ) to heat (make steam).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 33:4">Targ. Is. XXXIII, 4</cite> <he>וַאֲזַן</he> (Regia <he>אֵיזִין</he>) and they shall heat (baths, ovens) therewith (h. text <he>מַשַּׂק</he> = <he>מַשַּׁק</he>), v. <cite ref="G00428"><he>זִירְקְתָא</he></cite>; (cmp.
<cite ref="Ezekiel 39:9">Ezek. XXXIX, 9</cite>). Ib. XLIV, 15 (for baking); a. e.—Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46ᶜ a bath house <he>דאזייה וכ׳</he> which he had heated for seven days.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:8">Koh. R. to II, 8</cite>; a. e. <he>דהוון אָזְיִין בהון</he> that entertained the fires in them.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>ועל מזגיה וקנחיה</he> (read <he>ואַזְּיֵיה</he> Pa.) and he (Haman) went and made him sweat and cleansed him (with the scraper).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>קלוון אנא דיִתְּזוּן וכ׳</he> I command that the bath-houses be heated.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אזלון ואִתְּזוּן</he> they went off, and the bath-houses were heated (some ed. <he>דְּיִחֲמוּן</he> a. <he>אַחְמוּן</he>).
